claim_assessments.reason: The exact witness over Q(t), t^2=125/313, gives total (2,45), norm 90 and all pointwise equations, with three distinct nonisotropic directions. A one-parameter isometry avoids any prescribed finite set. The manuscript's general-small-parameter proof is also consistent.

An explicit elliptic order-four starting point exists. The 21-dimensional lift family has an off-Gamma singular incidence of dimension at most 20; six proper normal-derivative hyperplanes can simultaneously be avoided. The implicit equation gives exact fourth-order contact; divisor cohomology gives connectedness and genus, and fixed normal-first adjunction gives the specified fourth root.

The restriction kernels have the required H0/H1 vanishings, and the two embedded marked schemes agree for every length at most four. The residual elliptic bundles 5F, Phi, nontrivial Delta, and -F+Delta give ranks 6,12,12,10; the j=3 ambient space is not confused with its ten-dimensional restriction.

The same constructed curve has every stated numerical datum, complete section space, multiplication identity, simple common zeros, spanning derivative rows and unramified marked pencil. Evaluation is onto for every n>=3, using the separate n=3, n=4 and all-negative-degree n>=5 cases. Versions revise dependency metadata: opaque inventory, its direct replacements, then explicit GAGA and CT duality; they do not change the theorem.

Unnormalized field-trace anti-diagonal matrices are perfect for every ramification index and all five degree-four partitions. The positive line is a subbundle on every fiber. A two-section evaluation argument and vanishing extension groups prove the special splitting (3,0,0,-3), radical and quotient. Dual evaluation is E/s even if other factors of that fiber ramify. The v2 broad import is properly retired in v3, not mathematically refuted.

Both full double-pole spaces are residue dual to one common adjoint jet space. Their common two-dimensional annihilator defines a global iota. Positive normal-first adjunction together with the negative contact coefficient gives s(0)=-b1^4/K0^2; the full triangular coefficient map has derivative term 2b1b2/K0-b1^2K1/K0^2 and fixes the isometry sign. Three distinct evaluation directions determine the form.

All simple theta principal parts globalize because every dual theta test vanishes at Z. One global P is obtained. The canonical differential P1*T/u1 gives the global pairing -V for every T using a regular degree-four fiber and unnormalized trace. It then forces all six determinants and total -90. Holomorphic additions and arbitrary compatible coordinate changes preserve the conclusions.

The proof supplies all curve and residue hypotheses simultaneously on a nonempty open family, not merely separate locally consistent identities. The five versions track explicit duality/GAGA assumptions and an alias correction; the statement is unchanged. This removes a prior conditional jet theorem's input-existence condition but proves no downstream analytic or affine endpoint.

The actual available primary passage states projective coherent cohomology comparison, with the following sentence explicitly including q=0. All uses here are on projective complex varieties with coherent algebraic sheaves; no affine comparison is inferred.

The recorded upstream inventory is accurate in historical scope. Its operative special cases are now justified by first-jet incidence, product Cech cohomology, the divisor Euler-characteristic argument and the read Serre/GAGA passages. General Bertini attribution is not asserted from a citation label, and the retired route is not called a failed theorem.

The manuscript indeed invokes Hartshorne III.6 and Grothendieck 1957 section 2. The earlier jet audit did not certify those applications. This assessment does not claim a primary-source reading of those general imports: the required perfection and special splitting are instead proved directly, so no live mathematical gap depends on them.

Serre's actual compact-manifold/divisor statements and cup-product passage apply to the smooth compact curves and line bundles. The positive-contour expression is a separate cutoff/Stokes derivation under the audit's stated Cech sign convention, not a sign convention attributed verbatim to Serre.

Excision and Stokes give zero total residue on a compact curve. A single-valued holomorphic function on an annulus has zero integral of its derivative on a closed path, with no meromorphic-extension assumption at the missing center.
